title: ManiGuard-Bench before a household VLA manipulation policy release
agent: Robot learning lead at a vision-language-action (VLA) policy developer who owns the release decision for a manipulation checkpoint bound for household and light-industrial robots.
decision: Delay the checkpoint release and add safety fine-tuning plus a runtime monitor vs release as planned.
theta_definition: theta=1: under nominal instructions in ordinary household scenes the VLA policy drops, topples or spills objects or lifts open containers out of order, on the physical robot and not only in simulation.
instrument: ManiGuard-Bench (1,000 household scenarios in OmniGibson with LTLf safety monitors and a matched physical Franka cell), run against the candidate VLA checkpoint in simulation and on the physical robot.

decision_facts: One end-to-end VLA policy, pi0.5, has been shown cleaning kitchens and bedrooms in entirely new homes [black2025pi05]. Consumer service robots, mainly domestic, sold almost 34.2 million units in 2025, and the IFR names safety standards among the key challenges limiting humanoid adoption [ifr2026servicerobots]. 1X takes US preorders for the NEO home humanoid at USD 20,000 with deliveries starting in 2026; it weighs 66 lbs and carries 18 lbs per arm [onex_neo_order]. The hazard needs no attacker: under nominal instructions in ordinary scenes a policy may spill, tip, collide or violate an ordering requirement, and physical damage is costly and difficult to reverse [peng2026maniguard]. Across fine-tuned VLAs, 6-21% of successful rollouts violated the safety specification, 21-42% of engaged rollouts violated, and the same unsafe behaviours recurred on a physical Franka [peng2026maniguard]. Fifteen tabletop policies above 90% mean success had 18-28% unsafe-episode rates, and 38-56% of successful RoboCasa-365 rollouts violated at least one safety clause [fan2026safevlabench]. Fine-tuning on safety-annotated demonstrations raised safe task completion from near zero to 7.5-29.8%, and more of the same demonstrations did not close the remaining gap [peng2026maniguard]. US fatality records identified 41 robot-related worker deaths in 1992-2017, 78% from robots striking the worker while operating under their own power [layne2023robotfatalities]. Google DeepMind states that avoiding a missed stop for a nearby human must be prioritised over avoiding unnecessary stops, that frontier models either miss over 40% of hazards or stop the robot 15% to 25% of the time, and that deterministic low-level guardrails remain necessary [geminirobotics2026safety].
instrument_facts: ManiGuard-Bench is by authors at Northwestern, Stanford and William & Mary [peng2026maniguard]. Six contact-rich household task families (Clutter, Cabinet, Stack, Lid, Jar, Dusty) form 200 locked base tasks, each with one in-distribution and four single-axis out-of-distribution variants, giving 1,000 locked scenarios [peng2026maniguard]. Each task carries an LTLf safety specification over physics-grounded predicates, compiled into a deterministic finite automaton that labels every simulation step; no learned classifier or LLM judge is used [peng2026maniguard]. Rollouts run closed-loop in OmniGibson; the headline metric is safe-success rate, and the violation rate among engaged rollouts is reported separately [peng2026maniguard]. Each policy is rolled out once per scenario under three seeds, 3,000 rollouts per policy, over 23,000 in total [peng2026maniguard]. The hardware check uses twelve matched Clutter and Cabinet cells on a physical Franka with 30 rollouts per cell per domain, scored by the operator, not the automaton [peng2026maniguard]. Pearson r between simulated and physical rates is 0.91 for task success, 0.88 for safe success and 0.09 for the violation rate [peng2026maniguard]. Zero-shot policies scored 78-83% safe, half to four-fifths of it from rollouts that never engaged an object, and renderer nondeterminism changed 39% of first-observation pixels between identically seeded runs [peng2026maniguard]. The 21,000 simulation rollouts of the main evaluation and three zero-shot baselines took 1,326 single-GPU hours on RTX 4090 GPUs; no dollar figure is published [peng2026maniguard]. Code, scenes, demonstrations and evaluated checkpoints are public on GitHub and Hugging Face; the stack requires a Linux machine with an NVIDIA RTX GPU [maniguard_github].
